qt: to the Commission Claudiu-Richard Târziu (ECR) Subject:

The European Commission’s proposal for the 2028-2034 MFF sets aside EUR 293.7 billion in income support for farmers across the EU. Under the new framework, agricultural funding would be integrated into the national and regional partnership plans (NRPPs), alongside other investment priorities. The Commission is also proposing a planned average level of areabased support ranging between EUR 130 and EUR 240 per hectare for each Member State. In Romania, around 9.88 million hectares of agricultural land were declared and around 708 000 payment claims were submitted in 2025. In view of the above, can the Commission answer the following: 1.

What are: the estimated amount allocated to Romania for farmer support in 2028-2034, the calculation method used, the direct payment guarantees and the timetable for clarifying the amounts and eligibility conditions?

How does it intend to ensure that the integration of CAP funding into the NRPPs will not reduce the predictability of direct payments and will not allow agricultural income support to be reduced in favour of other national funding priorities?

When will it provide Member States and farmers with sufficiently detailed estimates of the expected support per hectare and the applicable eligibility conditions so that farmers can plan their investments and activity for the post-2027 period?
